simple.meaning: שָׂטַן (sâṭan) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to attack , (figuratively) accuse.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 6 times in Psalms, Zechariah, beginning at Psalms 38:21. The surrounding contexts include priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׂטַן (H7853) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׂטַן (sâṭan) / H7853 is traced through Psalms 38:21, Psalms 71:13, Psalms 109:4, Psalms 109:20 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H7853. satan [ שָׂטַן ] verb denominative (Gerber 30 ) be or act as adversary ; — Qal Imperfect 3masculine plural suffix יִשְׂטְנוּנִי Psa 38:21 ; 109:4 ; Infinitive construct suffix לְשִׁטְנוֺ Zech 3:1 ; Participle plural construct שׂטְנֵי Psa 71:13 , suffix שׂטְנַי 109:21 , שׂטְנַי 109:20 , שׂוֺטְנַי 109:29 .

occurrences.englishText: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed.
In return for my love, they are my adversaries;
This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh,
Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor.
He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before Yahweh’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.
